# D: Workflows

## Goal

Workflow orchestration as configuration — `spur workflow` over
`@gobing-ai/ts-dual-workflow-engine`; Spur builds no orchestration machinery of its own.

## Scope

`spur workflow validate|run|list|trace|continue`, workflow YAML under `./config/workflows`,
engine execution adapters, EventBus seam consumption.
